ov: ليلة في المتحف: سر قبر (الإنجليزية: Night at the Museum: Secret of the Tomb) هو فيلم تم إنتاجه في الولايات المتحدة وصدر يوم 19 ديسمبر 2014. الفيلم من إخراج شون ليفي.
plotEn:
In 1938, archaeologists are searching for the tomb of pharaoh Ahkmenrah in Egypt. The Tablet of Ahkmenrah is found. As the tombs artifacts are being packed, the locals warn against removing the tablet from the tomb, saying "the end will come."
Seventy-six years later in New York City, five years after the events of the second film, Larry Daley is still the Museum of Natural History night guard. He and the exhibits are hosting an event to help re-open the Hayden Planetarium. The exhibits inform Larry that the museum commissioned a new Neanderthal model that resembles him. The new Neanderthal calls himself Laaa and considers Larry his father. Later, Ahkmenrah shows Larry that the tablet has a mysterious corrosion. As the corrosion spreads, the exhibits act abnormally and cause massive chaos at the planetarium. After calming the situation, a frustrated Larry returns home where teenage son Nick, is throwing a party. After, they discuss Nick's future.
To discover what is happening to the tablet, Larry seeks out former museum guard Cecil Fredericks, now living in a retirement community following his release from prison. Cecil, whose father was the archaeologist who found the tablet, remembers, "the end will come" prophecy and realizes the tablet's magic is ending and the exhibits are becoming lifeless. Cecil says Ahkmenrah's parents, Merenkahre and Shepseheret, who are in the British Museum, may be able to restore the tablet's power.
